basis: Verified missing from the0.3 source. Priority score=impact/effort; both are engineering estimates on a1–5 scale. Dependencies may require foundation work first. Existing features do not count.

features.name: Duplicate tabs
features.acceptance: Copy body/page settings to a fresh id; later edits independent.

features.name: Replace images
features.acceptance: Replace source while retaining display width and wrapping.

features.name: RTL paragraphs
features.acceptance: Apply LTR/RTL independently of paragraph alignment.

features.name: Rotate images
features.acceptance: Rotate pixels 90 degrees and persist new image/dimensions.

features.name: Change text case
features.acceptance: Upper/lower/title/sentence case only selected text, preserving marks.

features.name: Whole-word search
features.acceptance: Exclude partial words while retaining case setting.

features.name: Paragraph borders/shading
features.acceptance: Apply/clear border and background across selected paragraphs; HTML reload retains.

features.name: Paragraph spacing
features.acceptance: Independent before/after spacing persists through reload/export.

features.name: Special characters
features.acceptance: Insert chosen symbol at saved editor selection.

features.name: Crop images
features.acceptance: Apply user crop bounds to actual pixels so reload/export retain crop.

features.name: Format painter
features.acceptance: Capture marks/paragraph formatting and apply to another selection without changing words.

features.name: Search all tabs
features.acceptance: Results navigate to exact text in correct tab.

features.name: Nested tabs
features.acceptance: Indent/outdent through three levels; preserve subtrees and promote children on delete.

features.name: Citation library
features.acceptance: Add/edit/remove local source metadata and insert citations; edits refresh references.

features.name: Automatic bibliography
features.acceptance: Bibliography refreshes cited sources and supports APA/MLA/Chicago display.

features.name: Bookmarks and internal links
features.acceptance: Name position, link/navigate to it, remove marker separately.

features.name: Column sections
features.acceptance: Wrap selected blocks in 2/3 columns; unwrap without losing contents.

features.name: Regex find/replace
features.acceptance: Validate patterns, ignore zero-length matches safely, support numbered replacement groups.

features.name: Sort paragraphs
features.acceptance: Sort complete selected paragraphs both directions, preserving marks; reject mixed structures.

features.name: Rendered equations
features.acceptance: Editable bounded fractions/roots/powers/subscripts/Greek render as MathML; unsupported syntax errors.

features.name: Trim whitespace cleanup
features.acceptance: Trim and collapse whitespace in selected literal text without rewriting formulas.

features.name: Format painter
features.acceptance: Capture one cell style and paint another selection in one action without changing values.

features.name: Alternating row colors
features.acceptance: Apply a header color and alternating body fills over a selected table, preserving values.

features.name: Cell notes
features.acceptance: Save, inspect and remove a cell note with visible grid indicator.

features.name: Freeze through selection
features.acceptance: Freeze multiple rows and columns through the selected cell and retain their offsets on scroll.

features.name: Text case cleanup
features.acceptance: Convert literal text to upper/lower/title case while preserving formulas, numbers and formatting.

features.name: Sheet tab colors
features.acceptance: Choose a saved worksheet tab color that remains visible after switching sheets.

features.name: Per-column filters
features.acceptance: Combine independent column criteria with AND while keeping the header visible.

features.name: Saved filter views
features.acceptance: Save, restore and delete named column-filter configurations after reopening JSON.

features.name: Multi-column sort
features.acceptance: Sort selected table by ordered ascending/descending keys without separating row cells.

features.name: Checkbox cells
features.acceptance: Insert toggleable checkbox cells whose TRUE/FALSE values feed formulas and persist.

features.name: Find and replace
features.acceptance: Replace matches in selection, sheet or workbook with case/whole-cell options and formula opt-in.

features.name: Remove duplicate rows
features.acceptance: Choose key columns and header handling; compact unique rows while preserving complete cell objects.

features.name: Split text into columns
features.acceptance: Split a selected text column by delimiter with quoted-field handling and safe destination checks.

features.name: Cell hyperlinks
features.acceptance: Attach and safely open an HTTP/HTTPS/mailto link without losing the cell value.

features.name: Paste transposed cells
features.acceptance: Paste a copied rectangle with rows/columns swapped and formula-relative references adjusted.

features.name: Custom-formula conditional formatting
features.acceptance: A relative formula evaluates per target cell, including cross-column conditions.

features.name: Custom-formula data validation
features.acceptance: Reject a proposed edit when its relative custom formula is false or errors, without changing saved cells.

features.name: Fill business days
features.acceptance: Fill dates forward while skipping Saturday/Sunday and preserving the first selected date.

features.name: Formula-safe cut
features.acceptance: Move cells and retarget dependent scalar and fully-contained range references across sheets, preserving anchors and literals; reject unsupported partial-range moves atomically.

features.name: Replace image in place
features.absentEvidence: Image upload always inserts a new object.
features.acceptance: Replace a selected local image while retaining its id, position, size, rotation, mask, crop, appearance and group.

features.name: Lock objects
features.absentEvidence: All objects remain draggable/deletable.
features.acceptance: Lock selected objects against drag, resize, keyboard movement and delete; unlock through object list/format controls; lock persists.

features.name: Skip hidden slides
features.absentEvidence: Presentation nextFrame visits every slide.
features.acceptance: Hide/unhide slides in filmstrip; editing retains them and live/HTML presentation skips them forward/back; no empty-deck dead end.

features.name: Equal object distribution
features.absentEvidence: Existing align controls only move the selection bounding box to slide edges/center.
features.acceptance: Distribute three or more unlocked selected objects horizontally/vertically with equal gaps, preserving endpoints, content and unselected geometry.

features.name: Cross-slide object clipboard
features.absentEvidence: SlidesEditor duplicateObjects appends only to current slide; no copy/cut/paste handler.
features.acceptance: Copy/cut selected objects, switch slides and paste preserving styles, groups and connector membership; cut clears only after a valid paste and stale sources reject.

features.name: Format painter
features.absentEvidence: No style capture/apply action exists.
features.acceptance: Capture an object's appearance and paint another compatible object or selection without copying content or geometry; undo restores the target.

features.name: Paragraph layout controls
features.absentEvidence: Text has fixed line-height1.25 and padding; no paragraph spacing/vertical alignment controls.
features.acceptance: Change line spacing, space before/after and vertical text alignment while retaining text and inline styles; presentation/export geometry follows.

features.name: Image masks
features.absentEvidence: Image renderer has no clipping mask.
features.acceptance: Apply ellipse/rounded/rectangle masks to images, retain crop and show the mask in presentation/SVG/HTML/PPTX.

features.name: Object and slide hyperlinks
features.absentEvidence: No hyperlink fields, controls or presentation click targets.
features.acceptance: Attach safe website/mail links or an internal slide target; activating during presentation opens the link or jumps to the slide without advancing accidentally; unsafe protocols reject.

features.name: Deck find and replace
features.absentEvidence: No text search/replace UI or helper.
features.acceptance: Find text across slides, jump to matches and replace one/all while preserving unrelated rich text; notes optionally included; undo restores edits.

features.name: Automatic footer and slide numbers
features.absentEvidence: No footer/number data or generated stage content.
features.acceptance: Set a deck footer, number start and visibility; all slides derive correct numbers through reorder and show them in presentation/exports.

features.name: PNG slide export
features.absentEvidence: Only SVG, HTML, JSON, PDF print and PPTX exports exist.
features.acceptance: Download the current slide as a real PNG at selectable1x/2x resolution with current rich text/crop/footer/background; decode failure is surfaced.

features.name: Append slides from a local deck
features.absentEvidence: Existing import replaces the whole presentation.
features.acceptance: Append JSON/PPTX slides to the current deck without replacing existing authored slides; remap object/group/slide/link identifiers and scale aspect ratios.

features.name: Photo slide backgrounds
features.absentEvidence: slide.background is color-only.
features.acceptance: Choose a local background image, cover/contain and opacity; replace/remove it while objects remain; presentation and exports include it.

features.name: Structured bulleted and numbered lists
features.absentEvidence: No paragraph/list data or bullet controls exist.
features.acceptance: Toggle real bullets/numbering and indent/outdent selected paragraphs; nesting and numbering render in presentation and exports.

features.name: Nondestructive image crop
features.absentEvidence: Images always objectFit contain; no crop metadata or viewport.
features.acceptance: Crop using a normalized visible rectangle and reposition it, reset without changing original source; editor/presentation/exports show the same crop.

features.name: Named slide sections
features.absentEvidence: Filmstrip is one flat list.
features.acceptance: Assign section names, show section headings and collapse/expand sections without changing slide content or order.

features.name: Smart snapping guides
features.absentEvidence: Pointer move simply rounds dx/dy; no guide matching.
features.acceptance: Moving a selection near slide/object edges or centers snaps within a tolerance and displays guides; toggle disables snapping.

features.name: Attached connectors
features.absentEvidence: Only detached line/arrow shapes exist.
features.acceptance: Connect two objects with an arrow that follows their move/resize; duplicate/paste remaps endpoints and deletion handles missing endpoints safely.

features.name: Per-word rich text
features.absentEvidence: RenderObject uses one e.text string and one style; editing is a textarea.
features.acceptance: Select a word, apply bold/italic/underline/color/font/size without changing neighboring words; content persists and appears in HTML/SVG/PPTX.

sharedExtras: Embed local Sheets ranges/charts in Docs and Slides; explicit source refresh
